method.population: Every figure on this page is computed each night from the live charter offers of the {priced, number} boats based {where} that have at least one bookable 7-night charter in the next 12 months. The month tables cover charters starting from {from} to {to}.
method.median: The typical week is the median weekly price: half of the priced charter weeks cost less, half cost more. The middle half is the range between the 25th and the 75th percentile of those weeks, so the cheapest and the most expensive quarter are left out.
method.panel: Within each table the months compare like with like: they are priced over the same boats, those with a price in at least three of every four months shown. A month appears only when at least half as many boats have a price in it as in the best-covered month, so thin off-season months are left out. Weeks priced under 300 € are placeholders and never count, and figures based on fewer than 5 boats are not shown.
method.costs: Prices are for the boat per charter week, as published by our partners. A skipper, obligatory extras and the security deposit come on top. Skipper and deposit figures are medians over the boats that list them. Obligatory extras are the per-boat fees for a week, counted as {zero} for a boat without any; per-person items such as tourist tax are not included, and boats with a percentage-based fee (APA on crewed yachts) are left out.
